**Node.js 22.0.0 的 GitHub release 页面是：**

https://github.com/nodejs/node/releases/tag/v22.0.0

抓取后的页面标题为：

> Release 2024-04-24, Version 22.0.0 (Current), @RafaelGSS and @marco-ippolito · nodejs/node · GitHub

页面上的发布信息：

- 标题：**2024-04-24, Version 22.0.0 (Current), @RafaelGSS and @marco-ippolito**
- 发布者：[RafaelGSS](https://github.com/RafaelGSS)，时间 **Apr 24, 2024**（24 Apr 18:25）
- 标签树：[v22.0.0](https://github.com/nodejs/node/tree/v22.0.0)
- 对应提交：[`12fb157`](https://github.com/nodejs/node/commit/12fb157f79da8c094a54bc99370994941c28c235)
- 签名：Rafael Gonzaga，GPG key ID `8BEAB4DFCF555EF4`，Verified

发布说明原句：

> We're excited to announce the release of Node.js 22!
>
> Highlights include require()ing ESM graphs, WebSocket client, updates of the V8 JavaScript engine, and more!
>
> As a reminder, Node.js 22 will enter long-term support (LTS) in October, but until then, it will be the "Current" release for the next six months.

Notable Changes 里还列出：默认启用 WebSocket、V8 更新到 12.4.254.14、`node --run`、`fs.glob` / `fs.globSync`，以及支持 `require()` 同步 ESM 图。

这次抓取在约 12000 字符处被截断，内容仍是 changelog，没有读到评论，因此没有可引用的评论原句。
